profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp is a public company traded under the ticker ZBRA, with CIK 0000877212, headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois. On its own site the company describes itself as "The World's Foundation for Intelligent Operations" and says it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate and enhance processes using mobile computers, scanners, printers and RFID. It also markets manufacturing technology solutions, including hardware and software for automation, data analysis and factory connectivity.

Its AI offerings, as described on the site, include Zebra Companion AI, which the company says provides instant, tailored insights and support for frontline work, and Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, which it describes as AI vision models, sample apps and APIs for streamlining workflows. Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints are presented as adaptable AI frameworks for automating manual tasks in frontline operations. The Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software addresses track-and-trace, vision inspection and industrial automation, and Zebra Aurora Focus is an interface for setting up, deploying and running the company's Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. Zebra describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built with partners in mind.

Litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with 375 matters. The site's copyright notice states that some content or images may have been created with the assistance of AI, and notes that the Zebra wordmark and logo are trademarks of Zebra Technologies Corp., registered in many jurisdictions worldwide.
